snippet.title: Trackastrophe! - Official Trailer | Mundo Gamer Showcase 2026 - Edition 01
snippet.description:
All aboard for a chaotic puzzle adventure!

Trackastrophe! is a fun and creative railway puzzle game where you build tracks, solve challenges, and expand your train through increasingly wild and surreal levels.

🛒 Add it to your Steam wishlist
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3419850/Trackastrophe/

🔥 About the Game

🧩 Puzzle-Based Gameplay
• Build railways using different track pieces
• Plan your route carefully to reach the goal

🌍 Surreal Worlds
• Explore multiple themed environments
• Each biome introduces new mechanics and obstacles

🚧 Creative Challenges
• Face portals, ice paths, tunnels, and tricky layouts
• Increasingly complex puzzles keep you engaged

🚂 Train Progression
• Expand your train by collecting new wagons
• Adapt your strategy as levels evolve

🎨 Customization
• Personalize your train with fun cosmetics
• Add style to your puzzle-solving journey

🧠 Accessible Yet Challenging
• Easy to learn mechanics
• Optional hints available when needed

🎮 Retro Cartoon Vibes
• Inspired by classic animated worlds
• Lighthearted and charming presentation
